full_judgment: 9. This is the case of the defendant No. 1 that she married the plaintiff but in support of her such claim she did not produce any Kabinnama. She examined herself as DW 1 and other witnesses examined in her favour are PW 2 Abdus Salam, who is known to both the plaintiff and the defendant, PW 3 is Maulvi Muslem Uddin, he was also was known person of both the plaintiff and the defendant, DW 4 was an employee under Deputy Commissioner and DW 5 Mosammat Dilruba, who is known person and close relation of the defendant No. 1 from the photo copy of the Kabinnama which was produced, we find that the witness put their signature on the Kabinnama are not examined. Signature appears in the photo copy of Kabinnama cannot be said the witness signed this Kabinnama as it is photo copy of certified copy and it was not exhibited, as such marriage as claim has not been proved. It is the case of defendant No. 1 that plaintiff married her, which plaintiff denies as such as per Section 103 of the Evidence Act defendant by reliable evidence is to prove there was marriage in between her and plaintiff. In the case of Chand Miah vs Khodeza Bibi, reported in 42 DLR 344 it is held that onus lies on defendant to prove her alternative story. In the instant case admittedly no Kabinnama has been produce as such entire onus to prove there was valid marriage lies upon defendant No. 1. Defendant failed to bring any reliable trustworthy witness even the father of defendant No. 1 was not produce as it is her case that after marriage she lived with plaintiff in her father's house to prove she with plaintiff lived there as husband and wife.
